calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, fade its completed three-session return relative to the same-date cross-sectional median across the 15-instrument universe. The factor is formed only from completed bars and forecasts the next close-to-close return. Dates with fewer than 8 valid instruments have no cross-sectional baseline.

validation.regime_notes: One-day IC remained positive across 2020-22 (0.05384), 2023-24 (0.04148), and 2025-26 (0.03863). Small cross-asset cross-sections imply conservative uncertainty interpretation.

provenance.observation_rule: All factor inputs are lagged through the prior completed trading day relative to the forecast return.
